Implementation checkpoint

Fast-forwarded the dedicated worktree to origin/main revision e2f7b130e039. Added a focused archive oracle that builds one wheel and one source archive. Before the metadata correction, both tests failed because the vendored MIT license was absent from both artifacts. After the correction, both tests pass and compare artifact bytes with repository source bytes for both licenses and both wordlists.

Updated the distribution license metadata, aligned the package and MCP summaries with the approved positioning, and corrected the skill frontmatter guidance. The focused package, skill, manifest, release-guard, and generated-surface set passed with 63 tests. The skill and server manifest checkers pass. Lint and type checking pass. Whitespace validation passes. Git confirms that both license files and both wordlists remain unchanged. The default suite remains pending.
